title: Blink, taken apart
dek: Chromium's rendering engine is 213,000 files, and 189,644 of them are web tests. This is a teardown of the rest: how third_party/blink is layered and how that layering is enforced, what runs on which thread, how a byte of HTML and a CSS property name become C++ classes, how one BeginMainFrame becomes pixels, and where Blink hands off to V8, to cc, and to //content. Everything is read at chromium/src@f288fed6 — Chrome 156.0.8067.0, 18 September 2026.
description: A teardown of Blink at chromium/src@f288fed6: layering, threads, the scheduler, bytes to pixels, Oilpan, bindings, runtime flags, web tests.
og_description: Chromium's rendering engine read end to end at commit f288fed6 (Chrome 156.0.8067.0): the tree and its DEPS-enforced layering, the process and thread model, the RenderingNG pipeline, Oilpan on cppgc, Web IDL bindings, runtime-enabled features and web tests.
twitter_description: Blink at chromium/src@f288fed6, taken apart: 213,000 files, a layering no build can violate, one main thread, twelve pipeline stages, and where the engine stops.
